claims.claim: 瑞典彩票(PLS/Kombi/Triss 三类,注册数据):中 100 万 SEK(约 $14 万)使中奖者前 10 年税前劳动收入累计减少约 8 万 SEK(≈半年平均收入);即每 10 万 SEK 中奖,10 年累计少挣 8,033 SEK;下降立即发生、大致恒定、持续 10 年以上,且按年龄/教育/性别差异小。
claims.quote: In our main specification, a windfall gain of 1 million Swedish krona (about $140,000) reduces the pre-tax labor earnings of the winner over the first 10 years by roughly 80,000 SEK, or approximately one half of the average annual income.
claims.source_title: Cesarini, Lindqvist, Notowidigdo, Östling, 2017, The Effect of Wealth on Individual and Household Labor Supply: Evidence from Swedish Lotteries, American Economic Review 107(12)(引自 NBER WP 21762, 2015 版正文)
claims.notes: 自然实验:条件于彩票类型/持票数后奖金随机。一次性财富冲击(Triss-Monthly 为月付),非 UBI 式全民永久转移;局部样本(购彩者)。数字取自 WP 版,AER 正式版系数可能小幅修订。资助:瑞典研究理事会、Handelsbanken 研究基金、NSF 等;无预注册(劳动供给论文)。'持续10年以上'中后期衰减主要因中奖者到达退休年龄。外部效度:作者与按年龄性别加权的代表性样本比较,称 'at least in terms of observable characteristics, we find no large differences between the players we study and a representative sample of the Swedish population';中奖时均龄 48.6 岁;不可观测偏好(风险、闲暇偏好)无法排除。

claims.claim: AER 正式版摘要:收入下降「温和」;校准生命周期模型给出终生边际收入倾向(MPE)随年龄从 20 岁的 -0.17 降到 60 岁的 -0.04(WP 版报告的是平均 -0.11);劳动供给弹性处于既往估计低端。
claims.quote: Winning a lottery prize modestly reduces earnings, with the reduction being immediate, persistent, and quite similar by age, education, and sex. A calibrated dynamic model implies lifetime marginal propensities to earn out of unearned income from -0.17 at age 20 to -0.04 at age 60, and labor supply elasticities in the lower range of previously reported estimates.
claims.source_title: Cesarini, Lindqvist, Notowidigdo, Östling, 2017, The Effect of Wealth on Individual and Household Labor Supply: Evidence from Swedish Lotteries, American Economic Review 107(12)
claims.notes: MPE 是'终生'口径(结构模型外推到前10年之外),不可与 Golosov 的'当期每$1非劳动收入'MPE(-0.5)直接比:前者分母是一次性财富总额,后者分母是年化的非劳动收入流。'modestly' 是作者措辞,外推到 UBI 需谨慎。

claims.claim: 调整边际:中 100 万 SEK 使参与率(年劳动收入>25,000 SEK)下降 2.07 个百分点;外延边际(退出)在中奖后即刻约占总响应的 50%,6 年后约 1/3;工时下降相当于全职的 3.11%(约每周 1.3 小时)——多数人减量而非辞职。
claims.quote: Winning 1M SEK reduces the probability of participation, defined as having labor earnings in excess of 25,000 SEK, by 2.07 percentage points.
claims.source_title: Cesarini, Lindqvist, Notowidigdo, Östling, 2017, The Effect of Wealth on Individual and Household Labor Supply: Evidence from Swedish Lotteries, American Economic Review 107(12)(NBER WP 21762 Table 4 讨论)
claims.notes: '外延边际占比'依赖'退出者收入等于样本均值'的假设(作者自述)。工时数据只来自薪资调查子样本。对'不工作的人'这一议题:绝大多数中奖者并未退出劳动力。

claims.claim: 配偶效应:已婚中奖者每中 100 SEK 少挣 0.98 SEK,未中奖配偶少挣 0.46 SEK,家庭合计 1.44;只看中奖者会低估家庭劳动供给响应约 24%;中奖者反应强于配偶(p=0.059),与单一家庭模型(收入共享)不符。
claims.quote: Table 7 shows the labor supply of married winners drops by 0.98 SEK for each 100 SEK won, compared to 0.46 for their spouses. The labor supply of the household is hence reduced by 1.44 SEK per 100 SEK.
claims.source_title: Cesarini, Lindqvist, Notowidigdo, Östling, 2017, The Effect of Wealth on Individual and Household Labor Supply: Evidence from Swedish Lotteries, American Economic Review 107(12)(NBER WP 21762 Table 7)
claims.notes: Golosov 等指出家庭内谁中奖并非随机(中奖者更可能是男性、在业、主要收入者),Cesarini 自己的 Table A.6 也有此证据,故'违背单一模型'的推论有识别保留。

claims.claim: 美国彩票中奖者(IRS 全量税务记录 × 第三方申报的州彩票奖金,1999–2016,事件研究用'晚中奖者'作对照):当期每多 $1 非劳动收入,税前劳动收入减少约 50 美分、劳动税减少 10 美分、消费增加 60 美分;高收入分位减得更多。
claims.quote: On average, an extra dollar of unearned income in a given period reduces pre-tax labor earnings by about 50 cents, decreases total labor taxes by 10 cents, and increases consumption by 60 cents.
claims.source_title: Golosov, Graber, Mogstad, Novgorodsky, 2024, How Americans Respond to Idiosyncratic and Exogenous Changes in Household Wealth and Unearned Income, Quarterly Journal of Economics 139(2)(引自 NBER WP 29000 修订版)
claims.notes: 口径:'unearned income'是把一次性奖金按年金化折成每年可分配的非劳动收入后计算的 MPE;按财富口径则是每 $100 财富年收入少 $2.3。作者为芝大+IRS SOI 合作,无预注册。样本是中奖者(自选购彩),奖金 ≥$20k 级别。与 Cesarini '温和' 结论看似冲突,主要来自分母口径不同;作者在引言直接反驳:'they conclude that income effects are modest. This conclusion, in turn, led a number of studies to build models specifically around the assumption that income effects are essentially negligible'。其他可能差异:税制社保、奖金规模(每$效应随奖金增大而减小)。

claims.claim: 每多 $10 万财富,中奖者就业概率下降 3.7 个百分点;最低收入四分位下降 5.2pp,最高四分位 2.3pp——低收入者更可能完全停工,但以美元计高收入者减得更多。
claims.quote: Finally, the probability that the winner is employed decreases by 3.7 percentage points per 100,000 dollars of additional wealth.
claims.source_title: Golosov, Graber, Mogstad, Novgorodsky, 2024, How Americans Respond to Idiosyncratic and Exogenous Changes in Household Wealth and Unearned Income, Quarterly Journal of Economics 139(2)(引自 NBER WP 29000 修订版)(Table 3.2)
claims.notes: Table 3.2:Winner Employment 全样本 -0.0368(SE 0.0008),Q1 -0.0517(0.0021),Q4 -0.0231(0.0010),均按每 $100,000 缩放。低收入者基期参与率低造成'天花板'问题,作者在附录做了子样本检验。

claims.claim: 临近退休(62–64 岁)中奖者:每 $10 万财富使连续 ≥1/2/5 年退出劳动力的概率上升约 5 个百分点(相对反事实均值 +11%–14%),而提前领取社保(OASI)只升约 1.1pp(作者称不显著,表中 SE 0.0041)。
claims.quote: In contrast, the propensity to leave the labor force for at least one, two or five consecutive years increases by around 5 percentage points per $100,000 of additional wealth on average.
claims.source_title: Golosov, Graber, Mogstad, Novgorodsky, 2024, How Americans Respond to Idiosyncratic and Exogenous Changes in Household Wealth and Unearned Income, Quarterly Journal of Economics 139(2)(引自 NBER WP 29000 修订版)(Table 6.1)
claims.notes: Table 6.1 一年退出 0.0489(SE 0.0053),反事实均值 0.43。正文称 OASI 效应 'statistically insignificant',但表中 0.0114/0.0041 看似显著——正文与表存在出入,待核对 QJE 终版。这是'财富→提前退休'的直接证据,把彩票线与退休线连起来。

claims.claim: 把估计映射到含非线性税、内外延边际的生命周期模型后,作者给出 UBI 下界:即便不计为融资而加税带来的抑制,每 $1 UBI 至少使总劳动收入减少 52 美分;若马歇尔收入弹性为 0.3,UBI 几乎一比一挤出收入;$12,000/年的 UBI 会显著降低平均家庭收入(约 $5 万)。
claims.quote: For example, even if one abstracts from any disincentive effects from higher taxes that are needed to finance this transfer program, each dollar of UBI will reduce total earnings by at least 52 cents. With the relatively modest disincentive effects of a Marshallian earnings elasticity of 0.3, a UBI crowds out earnings essentially one for one.
claims.source_title: Golosov, Graber, Mogstad, Novgorodsky, 2024, How Americans Respond to Idiosyncratic and Exogenous Changes in Household Wealth and Unearned Income, Quarterly Journal of Economics 139(2)(引自 NBER WP 29000 修订版)
claims.notes: 这是模型外推(部分均衡、个体冲击),不是 UBI 实验结果。个体中奖不改变同伴、工资、社会规范与需求——全民 UBI 有一般均衡与规范效应,方向不定。'劳动收入下降'本身不等于福利下降(闲暇/照料价值未计)。

claims.claim: 马萨诸塞彩票(1980 年代中期购彩者,奖金分 20 年按年支付):非劳动收入降低劳动收入,'消费闲暇的边际倾向'约 11%,55–65 岁效应更大;拿到约一半奖金时储蓄约 16%。
claims.quote: We find that unearned income reduces labor earnings, with a marginal propensity to consume leisure of approximately 11 percent, with larger effects for individuals between 55 and 65 years old. After receiving about half their prize, individuals saved about 16 percent.
claims.source_title: Imbens, Rubin, Sacerdote, 2001, Estimating the Effect of Unearned Income on Labor Earnings, Savings, and Consumption: Evidence from a Survey of Lottery Players, American Economic Review 91(4):778-794
claims.notes: 奖金为 20 年年金,形式上最接近'定期无条件收入流',但有期限。资助 NSF+Sloan,彩票委员会配合。WP 版:年 $15,000 的'小奖'对工时无显著影响,$80,000 vs $15,000 才降工时(弹性约 -0.2);有基期零收入者在小奖后参与率反而上升的迹象。邮寄调查总应答率约 46%(中奖者 42%、未中者 49%),样本数百人;Cesarini 等脚注指其估计 'highly non-linear' 且对少数 >$200 万中奖者与非随机无应答敏感(Hirano & Imbens 2004)。

claims.claim: 瑞典购彩者调查(中奖后 5–22 年,N=3,362,奖池 $2.77 亿,按预注册分析计划 OSF t3qb5):税后每 $10 万奖金使总体生活满意度提高 0.037 SD,且随中奖后年数不衰减——拒绝'完全享乐适应'。
claims.quote: According to our estimate, an after-tax prize of $100,000 improves life satisfaction by 0.037 standard-deviation (SD) units. We find no evidence that the effect varies by years-since-win, suggesting a limited role for hedonic adaptation over the time horizon we analyze.
claims.source_title: Lindqvist, Östling, Cesarini, 2020, Long-run Effects of Lottery Wealth on Psychological Well-being, Review of Economic Studies 87(6)(引自 NBER WP 24667, 2018)
claims.notes: 预注册:Östling, Lindqvist & Cesarini 2016, https://osf.io/t3qb5/ 。未调查中奖 5 年内的人,不能检验短期适应。效应量小:0.037 SD/$10万,作者称与年收入梯度相当。伦理审批 2016/524-31/5。

claims.claim: 测量口径分化:同一样本中评价型指标(总体生活满意度 0.037 SD、财务满意度 0.067 SD/$10 万)显著;情感型指标(幸福感 0.016、GHQ-12 精神健康 0.013)不显著,且可拒绝与生活满意度等效(p<0.001),尽管两者相关 0.86;财务满意度是主要中介。
claims.quote: The estimated effects on Overall LS and Financial LS are, respectively, 0.037 SD units and 0.067 SD units per $100,000 won, and remain significant after our multiple-hypothesis adjustment. For Happiness and Mental Health, the corresponding point estimates are 0.016 and 0.013, respectively.
claims.source_title: Lindqvist, Östling, Cesarini, 2020, Long-run Effects of Lottery Wealth on Psychological Well-being, Review of Economic Studies 87(6)(引自 NBER WP 24667, 2018)
claims.notes: 这是本线最关键的口径陷阱:'钱让人更满意'≠'钱让人更快乐/精神更健康'。Happiness 在本文是混合型单题,Mental Health 用 GHQ-12。写作中'幸福'一词必须标注是 life satisfaction 还是 affect。

claims.claim: Lindqvist 等重估既往彩票-幸福研究:在其精度下,报告精神健康显著改善的三项早期研究(Lindahl 2005、Gardner & Oswald 2007、Apouey & Clark 2015)统计功效仅 5.02%–6.55%,显著结果有 15%–45% 概率符号错误、效应至少被高估 5 倍。
claims.quote: Then the statistical power of the three previous studies reporting statistically significant effects on mental health (Lindahl 2005, Gardner & Oswald 2007, Apouey & Clark 2015) ranged from 5.02% to 6.55% (at α = 0.05).
claims.source_title: Lindqvist, Östling, Cesarini, 2020, Long-run Effects of Lottery Wealth on Psychological Well-being, Review of Economic Studies 87(6)(引自 NBER WP 24667, 2018)(footnote 16)
claims.notes: 该功效计算假设早期研究的真实效应等于本文 95% CI 上限(0.044 SD),作者自承可能不适用(短期效应可能更大、小奖非线性)。但它是对'彩票改善精神健康'早期证据的直接方法批评。

claims.claim: Brickman 等 1978(伊利诺伊):22 名大奖得主 vs 22 名同区对照 vs 29 名此前访谈的瘫痪事故受害者;得主不比对照更快乐,且从日常琐事中得到的乐趣更少。WDH 收录的原表数值:当前幸福(0–5)得主 4.00、对照 3.82、事故受害者 2.96,受害者显著低于两组——'截瘫者恢复到和中奖者一样快乐'是流行误读。
claims.quote: Study 1 compared a sample of 22 major lottery winners with 22 controls and also with a group of 29 paralyzed accident victims who had been interviewed previously. As predicted, lottery winners were not happier than controls and took significantly less pleasure from a series of mundane events.
claims.source_title: Brickman, Coates, Janoff-Bulman, 1978, Lottery winners and accident victims: Is happiness relative?, Journal of Personality and Social Psychology 36(8):917-927
claims.notes: 摘要逐字核对(PubMed)。数值来自 World Database of Happiness 条目(https://worlddatabaseofhappiness-archive.eur.nl/correlational-findings/413/:'Accident victims: M=2.96 ... Controls: M=3.82 ... Both difference with lottery winners and controls significant'),属二手整理,原文 PDF 未取得。受害者为面访、得主/对照为电话访问(模式差异);横截面、非随机、得主奖金 ≥$5 万、应答率低(WDH 记 ~48% 无应答)。Lindqvist 等将其重标后得 0.014(SE 0.025),与他们的 Happiness 估计接近——即'无效应'在情感型指标上大体被现代研究支持,但对生活满意度不成立。

claims.claim: Gardner & Oswald(英国 BHPS,中奖 £1,000–£120,000):与无中奖、小额中奖两组对照相比,中奖者'最终'心理健康显著更好,中奖两年后 GHQ 平均改善 1.4 分。
claims.quote: When compared to two control groups – one with no wins and the other with small wins – these individuals go on eventually to exhibit significantly better psychological health. Two years after a lottery win, the average measured improvement in mental wellbeing is 1.4 GHQ points.
claims.source_title: Gardner & Oswald, 2007, Money and mental wellbeing: A longitudinal study of medium-sized lottery wins, Journal of Health Economics 26(1):49-60(IZA DP 2233 摘要)
claims.notes: 中奖者样本很小(约百余人)、奖金'中等'、对照非同彩种内随机;Lindqvist 等认为功效极低(见 W12)。测量是 GHQ-12(情感/精神健康),与生活满意度不同口径。

claims.claim: Apouey & Clark(英国 BHPS 面板,个体固定效应):中奖带来的正收入冲击对自评总体健康无显著影响,但显著改善精神健康;同时中奖与更多吸烟和社交饮酒相关,作者以此解释两者背离。
claims.quote: Positive income shocks have no significant effect on self-assessed overall health, but a significant positive effect on mental health.
claims.source_title: Apouey & Clark, 2015, Winning Big but Feeling no Better? The Effect of Lottery Prizes on Physical and Mental Health, Health Economics 24(5):516-538
claims.notes: Lindqvist 等引述:效应出现在中奖两年后的测量,而非中奖次年。同样面临小样本功效问题。'钱→更健康行为'不成立:摘要原文 'lottery winnings are also associated with more smoking and social drinking'。

claims.claim: Morse & Weiss 1955(美国就业男性全国样本)提出'若继承足够财富是否仍会工作'问题,结论是工作对大多数人不只是谋生手段;Vecchio 1980 用 1970 年代 GSS 重做,多数人仍会继续工作,但'纯为经济目的'工作的比例上升。常被引的'约 80% 会继续工作'未能回到原文核对。
claims.quote: While the new study finds that the majority of workers still work for the aforementioned reasons, the proportion of people who work solely for economic purposes is greater.
claims.source_title: Vecchio, 1980, The Function and Meaning of Work and the Job: Morse and Weiss (1955) Revisited, Academy of Management Journal 23(2):361-367(经 On Work 书目库摘要);原始:Morse & Weiss 1955, ASR 20(2):191-198
claims.notes: 引语来自书目库对 Vecchio 的摘要转述,非原文;Morse & Weiss 原文在 JSTOR(2088325)付费墙后,'80%'数字未核实。这是假设性问题(说的),与 Cesarini/Golosov 的行为数据(做的)互补:真中奖者也大多没有辞职。Arvey 等 2004 已由 JOBLESS 线收录(85.5% 中奖后继续工作,应答率约 16%)。

claims.claim: Rohwedder & Willis(HRS/ELSA/SHARE 跨国比较,用各国养老金/税收/残障政策作工具变量):提前退休对 60 岁出头者的认知能力有显著、量化重要且因果的负效应('mental retirement')。
claims.quote: We find that early retirement has a significant negative impact on the cognitive ability of people in their early 60s that is both quantitatively important and causal. Identification is achieved using national pension policies as instruments for endogenous retirement.
claims.source_title: Rohwedder & Willis, 2010, Mental Retirement, Journal of Economic Perspectives 24(1):119-138(PubMed 20975927 / PMC2958696 摘要)
claims.notes: 识别是国家层面的政策差异(约 13 国截面),作者自称'informal'论证;易受国家层面混杂(教育、文化、测量)影响。Bonsang 等 2012 JHE 用美国社保领取年龄作 IV 也得到负效应;Coe 等 2012 得到相反结果(W18)。效应幅度原文未抓到(PMC 有 reCAPTCHA)。

claims.claim: 反方:Coe 等用 HRS 中雇主提供的提前退休窗口作工具变量,OLS 显示退休时长与认知负相关,但 IV 估计表明并非因果;白领无清晰关系,蓝领若有则为正。
claims.quote: Specifically, we find no clear relationship between retirement duration and later-life cognition for white-collar workers and, if anything, a positive relationship for blue-collar workers.
claims.source_title: Coe, von Gaudecker, Lindeboom, Maurer, 2012, The effect of retirement on cognitive functioning, Health Economics 21
claims.notes: 仅老年男性。说明认知效应方向取决于识别策略与职业类型:'工作维持心智'对重复性体力劳动者可能不成立。

claims.claim: Insler(HRS,以首期自报'62/65 岁后仍工作的概率'作工具变量):退休对健康有显著有益效应,部分通过更健康的习惯(戒烟、运动)实现。
claims.quote: Results indicate that the retirement effect on health is beneficial and significant. Investigation into behavioral data, such as smoking and exercise, suggests that retirement may affect health through such channels.
claims.source_title: Insler, 2014, The Health Consequences of Retirement, Journal of Human Resources 49(1):195-233
claims.notes: 工具变量是个人主观预期,排他性约束存疑(预期本身可能反映健康轨迹)。健康口径是一般健康指数,不是幸福或认知。

claims.claim: Fé & Hollingsworth(BHPS,英国):短期用断点设计(对弱工具稳健),长期用强假设参数模型;发现退休对健康影响很小,但退休可能开启'久坐、社交贫乏'的生活,构成长期间接风险通道。
claims.quote: We apply our framework to the British Household Panel Survey and find that retirement has little effect on health. However, our estimates suggest that retirement opens the gate to a sedentary life with an impoverished social component and this is a channel through which retirement could indirectly affect health in the long run.
claims.source_title: Fé & Hollingsworth, 2016, Short- and long-run estimates of the local effects of retirement on health, Journal of the Royal Statistical Society Series A 179(4):1051-1067
claims.notes: 标题即强调'local':断点只识别在法定领取年龄附近被诱导退休的人(complier)的短期效应;长期效应要靠作者自称的'strong assumptions'。

claims.claim: Kolodziej & García-Gómez(SHARE,利用各国各时期退休资格年龄差异):退休对精神健康有保护作用,且分布不均——在抑郁风险临床阈值附近的人获益更大,女性与蓝领更大。
claims.quote: We find unequally distributed protective effects of retirement on mental health. These gains are larger among those just below and above the clinically defined threshold of being at risk of depression. The preserving effects are larger for women and blue collar workers.
claims.source_title: Kolodziej & García-Gómez, 2019, Saved by retirement: Beyond the mean effect on mental health, Social Science & Medicine
claims.notes: brief 中的'Kolodziej & García-Gómez 2019'核实为 Soc Sci Med 而非 Econ & Human Biology。精神健康口径为 EURO-D 抑郁量表(从摘要'risk of depression'推断,未读正文)。与 Heller-Sahlgren 用相近数据和识别却反号。

claims.claim: Heller-Sahlgren(SHARE 十国,以法定养老金年龄阈值作 IV + 个体固定效应,借鉴断点思路):退休对精神健康无短期效应,但有'大的'长期负效应,对男女及不同教育/职业背景同样成立。
claims.quote: The results display no short-term effects of retirement on mental health, but a large negative longer-term impact.
claims.source_title: Heller-Sahlgren, 2017, Retirement blues, Journal of Health Economics 54
claims.notes: 作者结论带政策倾向('reforms inducing people to postpone retirement ... could also pay a mental health dividend')。与 Kolodziej(保护)及 van der Heide(有益)冲突:差异可能来自时间窗(短 vs 长)、样本国家与波次、精神健康量表、是否以首次跨过阈值定义。'长期'的具体年数正文未抓到。

claims.claim: van der Heide 等系统综述(22 项纵向研究,11 项高质量):有'强证据'表明退休有益精神健康,对一般健康与身体健康证据矛盾;很少有研究区分自愿/非自愿/法定退休及蓝白领。
claims.quote: Strong evidence was found for retirement having a beneficial effect on mental health, and contradictory evidence was found for retirement having an effect on perceived general health and physical health. Few studies examined the differences between blue- and white-collar workers and between voluntary, involuntary and regulatory retirement with regards to the effect of retirement on health outcomes.
claims.source_title: van der Heide, van Rijn, Robroek, Burdorf, Proper, 2013, Is retirement good for your health? A systematic review of longitudinal studies, BMC Public Health 13:1180
claims.notes: 纳入的是纵向观察研究(best evidence synthesis),多数不处理'健康差→退休'的反向因果,不等于因果证据。

claims.claim: Filomena & Picchio 元分析(2000–2021 年 85 篇、308 个估计,含发表偏倚检验):退休对健康的平均效应'非常小且勉强显著';异质性来自健康测量与退休制度,强制或非自愿退休与(小的)负效应相关。
claims.quote: Using meta-regression analysis and after checking for the presence of publication bias, we found that the average effect of retirement on health outcomes is very small and barely significant, under the assumption of a common true effect. ... In particular, mandatory or involuntary retirement is associated with a negative impact of retirement on health, although it is small in magnitude.
claims.source_title: Filomena & Picchio, 2023, Retirement and health outcomes in a meta-analytical framework, Journal of Economic Surveys 37(4):1120-1155
claims.notes: 元分析把身体健康、精神健康、自评健康、医疗利用、死亡率合并,口径混合;正文表格显示精神健康类 105 个估计中正向 33、负向 12、零 60。引语中省略号为本线所加,两句均为摘要原文。

open_questions: Morse & Weiss 1955 原文(JSTOR 2088325)付费墙,'约 80% 会继续工作'及样本量(常引 401 名就业男性)未核实;Vecchio 1980 原文同样未取得。
Brickman 1978 原文 PDF 未取得;具体幸福均值来自 World Database of Happiness 整理,两条 WDH 条目对'得主-对照差异'显著性表述不一致(一条 ns,一条称受害者与两组都显著)。
Rohwedder & Willis 2010 效应幅度(词语回忆分数下降多少)未抓到:PMC 页面触发 reCAPTCHA,AEA PDF 被 Cloudflare 拦截。
Golosov 等正文称 OASI 领取效应 statistically insignificant,但 Table 6.1 为 0.0114(SE 0.0041);需核对 QJE 2024 终版是否修正。QJE 终版(academic.oup.com)未访问,数字来自 NBER WP 修订版。
Cesarini 等 AER 终版正文数字(8,033 SEK/10 万、-2.07pp、配偶 0.98/0.46)取自 2015 WP,终版可能小幅变化;AER 摘要的 MPE 已与 WP 不同(-0.17→-0.04 按年龄 vs 平均 -0.11)。
Heller-Sahlgren 2017 '长期'的具体年限与效应量(EURO-D 分数)未取得正文;Kolodziej & García-Gómez 的量表亦为推断。
外推缺口(论证,非数据):彩票是自选购彩人群的个体、部分均衡冲击;退休是年龄相关、社会认可、有身份叙事('退休者')的退出。二者都无法回答'全社会不再需要劳动'时的规范、身份与同伴效应——是否存在大规模、非老年、社会认可的非工作群体的因果证据(如长期失业对照已在 JOBLESS 线)?
